import html from typing import Final # Pre‑defined HTML template for a blog post. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced with the # escaped headline and content. BLOG_FORMAT: Final[str] = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_article_page(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Return a fully escaped and HTML‑formatted blog post. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. content : str The full text of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the rendered HTML. The headline and content are escaped to prevent XSS, newlines in the content are converted to
tags for proper rendering. Raises ------ ValueError If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str) or not isinstance(content, str): raise ValueError("Both headline and content must be strings") # Escape special HTML characters to prevent injection. safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) # Escape content and preserve line breaks. escaped_content = html.escape(content, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Use format to insert the sanitized values into the template. rendered = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=escaped_content) return rendered
